findings.title: Unresolved correct legacy rows do not block re-serving the same question as new, so XP/ability are counted twice
findings.problem: `historyIndex` puts rows with `unclassified: true` into `idx.unresolved`, and migration 020 produces such rows whenever a legacy row matches both bank and built-in identities with the same category. `unseenQuestions` only blocks `idx.unresolved` for incorrect rows with more than one peer (`correct === false && peers > 1`), and `settledResult` never consults `idx.unresolved` at all. A catalog question with that raw id therefore has `settled.state === "none"`, is offered as new, and `answerXp` cannot see a canonical match because the old row remains unclassified.
findings.failure_scenario: A saved blob contains `log: [{ id: 7, correct: true, unclassified: true, key: null }]` after ambiguous relabeling. The catalog contains bank question 7 (`source: "bank", key: "bank:7"`). `unseenQuestions` returns bank 7; answering it again pays `10 * diff` and increments ability `n`, readiness, daily count, and review history even though the student already answered that question correctly. There is also no resolution UI for correct unresolved rows, so the ambiguity never gets repaired.
findings.fix: Make any unresolved raw id block the corresponding catalog questions from `unseenQuestions`/new-question selection until it is resolved, and make `settledResult` return `pending` for such rows. Offer resolution for unresolved rows regardless of `correct`, or mark them seen by canonical identity once a catalog match is established.

findings.title: Protected feature label changed
findings.problem: The updated dashboard shows a task labeled 'Fix a miss' instead of the protected 'Review Misses' label.
findings.failure_scenario: Students see a renamed feature, violating the requirement not to rename the protected 'Review Misses' feature.
findings.fix: Change the label back to 'Review Misses'.

assessment:
Text pass: One scoring-identity defect will reach students: legacy correct answers left unresolved can be re-served as new and pay XP/ability credit again.

Picture pass: After review, the updated today-dashboard renames the protected 'Review Misses' feature to 'Fix a miss'. No other visible defects found.
